'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jonny Chu LS You Can Either Profit By This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Lightsaber. Transcription note: fast scrawl; the objective is written at line 54 ("You can either profit... OBJ"); line 1 and line 31 are illegible and shown as (illegible); line 59 "Tat..." struck and replaced with "JP: Audience Chamber"; shield 8 struck with an unclear replacement

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
